posts.searchText: 大休学理论：用间隔年探索实习与科研 Big Gap Year Theory 以带有玩笑意味的提问，讨论本科一年级后休学一年投入实习与科研的可能性。 Playfully proposes a gap year after freshman year to explore internships and research. Pegasus Bluie GunpowderTwi

大空仓理论：短期会被 LLM 解决的能力是否值得投入 Big Empty Position Theory 主张审视那些短期内可能被 LLM 替代、却需要大量投入的能力，把精力用于更有判断力的努力；并非倡导什么都不做。 Questions heavy investment in skills LLMs may soon automate and argues for more discerning effort, rather than doing nothing. Greg Hu greghxm_1
大审美理论 The Research Aesthetics Theory 讨论研究选题、论文呈现、报告、简历与个人主页中的审美判断，以及清晰表达的价值。 Examines judgment and presentation in research questions, papers, talks, résumés, and personal websites. NoaX noahatwhere

关于科研展示与设计的讨论 Research Communication and Design 这篇前导讨论把设计视为科研交流的一部分，主张降低理解成果的成本；原帖同时介绍作者自己的设计产品。 A precursor discussion arguing that design can make research easier to understand; the original also promotes the author’s design product. NoaX noahatwhere

对大斜率理论的反思 A Critique of High-Slope Research 质疑把短期可验证的高回报当作唯一准则，提醒读者考虑需要长期探索的研究。 Challenges an exclusive focus on quickly measurable returns and draws attention to research that requires prolonged exploration. scr.c silsrc

大 PR 理论：资助后的公关传播 Big PR Theory: Public Relations 以讽刺性的传播路线讨论拿到资助后通过媒体、采访、播客和报告塑造公众形象并吸引投资。这里的 PR 指公关传播。 Satirizes a publicity strategy of media coverage, interviews, podcasts, and talks after securing grants to attract investors. PR here means public relations. Zhilin Wang zhilinjerrywag

反思大斜率理论：踏实积累与长期手艺 A Critique of Big Slope Theory: Durable Craft 以基础设施、数据直觉和训练经验为例，反驳只有热点方向才有价值的看法，强调长期积累。 Uses infrastructure, data intuition, and training experience to challenge the idea that only fashionable directions have value. 月球大叔 uncle_moon_x

大开放理论 The Openness Theory 主张在学科、与人交往、前沿技术和科研失败面前保持学习意愿，避免先入为主的评价妨碍交流。 Encourages openness to disciplines, people, new technology, and research setbacks, rather than letting preconceptions prevent learning. Jie (Sophia) Gao jiegaosophia

大本质理论：技术变革中的百家争鸣 Big Essence Theory 将科研圈新理论的涌现比作社会剧变中的百家争鸣，认为 AI 正使既有工作、研究和生活经验失效。 Compares the proliferation of research theories to competing schools during social upheaval, arguing that AI disrupts inherited experience. Yue Su Selen7005717917

支持大斜率理论：顺着基座演进增加杠杆 Supporting Big Slope Theory: Building on Foundation Models 结合从 AI safety 到 agent 的转向经历，主张重视真实生产反馈，并顺着基座模型演进选择方向。 Draws on pivots from AI safety to agents to argue for production feedback and research aligned with foundation-model progress. Victor Huang @NeurIPS 2026 🇦🇺 VictorSJHuang

关于研究生阶段杠杆与选择的讨论 Leverage and Choices in Graduate Research 区分投入努力与选择值得投入的事情，讨论研究生如何重新审视评价体系，并对可能改变人生方向的决定负责。 Distinguishes working hard from choosing worthwhile work, asking graduate researchers to reassess inherited measures of success and take responsibility for major decisions. NoaX noahatwhere

大水群理论 The Group Chat Theory 把持续参与小型技术与科研社群视为建立关系的方法，强调反复交流带来的熟悉感与合作机会。 Treats sustained participation in small technical and research communities as a way to build familiarity, relationships, and collaboration opportunities. Chengxing Xie Chengxing_Xie

支持大斜率理论：方向转换的经验 Supporting Big Slope Theory: Lessons from Research Pivots 以跨越 3D grounding、自动驾驶、机器人和 LLM 的经历，讨论面对更有价值方向时及时转向。 Reflects on moves across 3D grounding, driving, robotics, and LLMs, advocating timely pivots toward more valuable directions. Qihang Peng PengQihang87687

大密度理论 The Time Density Theory 用单位时间内活动的价值解释成长差异，关注能够改善后续判断与行动的投入。 Explores differences in growth through the value of activities per unit of time, especially investments that improve later decisions. GeminiLight geminitfwang

大理论理论 The Theory of Making Theories 鼓励博士生把自己的认识整理成可讨论的框架，以澄清研究方向并让潜在合作者理解自己。 Encourages doctoral researchers to articulate frameworks that clarify their thinking and make their interests legible to collaborators. Greg Hu greghxm_1

大合作理论 The Collaboration Theory 从转向大模型研究的经历出发，强调选择合作者、及时公开工作，以及进入活跃研究网络。 Lessons from moving into LLM research: find collaborators, release work promptly, and participate in productive research networks. 鸭基米德 persdre
大吞噬理论 The Great Absorption Theory 基模的扩张正在重新划定研究与工作的边界，这篇讨论把它放到更广泛的社会变化中。 A discussion of how expanding foundation-model capabilities reshape research, work, and society. NoaX noahatwhere
大Bench理论：基模吞噬下PhD只能造bench Big Bench Theory 讨论将研究方向转化为基模友好的问题、数据与评测任务。 Discusses framing research as foundation-model-friendly problems, datasets, and benchmarks. Xinye (Victor) Li vclee8
HR理论：AI PhD更适合转行做HR HR Theory 将博士生的传播、技术判断、人脉和工具能力与招聘工作类比。 Compares PhD communication, technical judgment, networks, and tool skills with recruiting work. Xuan (Billy) Zhang xzhang_billy
大日结理论 Big Daily Settlement Theory 从互信下降与技能变化讨论工作结算周期的缩短。 Discusses shorter settlement cycles for work amid declining trust and changing skills. 鸭基米德 persdre
大斜率理论：做斜率最高的事 Big Slope Theory 主张优先投入进展斜率较高的事情。 Argues for prioritizing activities with a higher rate of progress. Yue Su Selen7005717917
大粉理论：推特/小红书粉丝 > Google Scholar引用 Big Fan Theory 以粉丝数量与学术引用的对比，讨论博士生的注意力资源。 Compares social-media followers with citations as resources for doctoral researchers. Collin Zhang collinzrj2001
大实习理论：真实反馈才是杠杆 Big Internship Theory 强调实习中获得的真实问题反馈，而非学校与头衔。 Emphasizes real-world feedback from internships over institutional titles. Xinye (Victor) Li vclee8
